name: consilium-principis
description: A personal advisory board of AI characters modelled on real thinkers. Public-domain figures ship in the box (Sun Tzu, Marcus Aurelius, Epictetus, Machiavelli); the skill builds profiles and runs a session on the user's question, the advisers argue with each other and with the user, then synthesis and a next step. Quotes come only from verified sources.
